assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'products' AND column_name = 'updated_at'

SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgrelid = 'public.products'::regclass AND t.tgname = 'trg_products_touch' AND t.tgfoid = to_regprocedure('public.touch_updated_at()') AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgtype = 19 AND t.tgenabled IN ('O','A')
assertions.message: trg_products_touch kører touch_updated_at som en aktiv BEFORE UPDATE-trigger pr. række

assertions.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM products WHERE updated_at IS NOT NULL)
assertions.message: Mindst ét produkt har et gemt tidsstempel efter din opdatering

assertions.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE products SET updated_at = TIMESTAMPTZ '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' WHERE id = 1 RETURNING updated_at) SELECT updated_at >= transaction_timestamp() AND updated_at <= clock_timestamp() FROM changed
assertions.message: En ny UPDATE får triggeren til at sætte et aktuelt tidsstempel
